market_question: Will Silver (SI) hit (HIGH) $120 by end of June?
reasoning: Silver currently trades near $30/oz and $120 is more than double its all-time nominal high of ~$50. Achieving a >300% rally within 15 months would require an unprecedented market dislocation, far exceeding past silver rallies. The implied probability of 6.6% grossly overstates the likelihood of such an extreme event.
evidence_points: Current price ~$30-35 implies a 300%+ increase needed
Historically, the largest 15-month rally for silver was about 200% (2009-2011) but that was from a low base after a crash, and still fell short of $120
